subject: english
source: CISCE Curriculum for Primary Classes I-V (2016), official

covers: Take part in meaningful discussions with teachers and classmates on a range of topics
Answer questions, comment, and add more to a topic
Report on a topic in an organised way, with facts and descriptive details
Tell a story or recount an experience in a logical order, at a clear pace
Enjoy English poems, songs, riddles and tongue twisters, and pick out the key ideas
Identify key situations, share ideas and give opinions
Take dictation of a passage they have read
Read texts with comprehension: find details, the order of ideas and events, and the main idea, in print or braille
Relate ideas to their own experience and self-awareness
Enjoy reading beyond the set text
Work out meanings of unfamiliar words from context, and use a dictionary or thesaurus
Write at least two paragraphs of about 150 words on a given topic
Write narratives with details of actions, thoughts, feelings and emotions
Link sentences with 'firstly', 'then', 'later' and 'finally' to show time and bring the piece to a close
Write letters to a parent, friend or relative
Learn common idioms, adages and proverbs, and explain their meaning
Make the subject and verb agree
Use capital letters correctly in titles of books and poems
Use punctuation correctly in dialogue
Show singular possession with an apostrophe, and tell plurals from possessives
Spell class-level words correctly, checking references when needed
Use age-appropriate vocabulary in context
